parsed.urgency_reason: Limitation deadline (2026-09-29) is only 9 days away from today (2026-09-20); complaint must be finalized, verified, and filed immediately to avoid time-bar. Stated urgency of 'medium' understates this risk.

red_flags.action: Confirm exact limitation trigger date (purchase vs. date of deficiency/denial), finalize draft, obtain client verification/signature, and file before 2026-09-29 without delay.
Obtain full registered address of XYZ Mobiles Service Centre and consider impleading the manufacturer/brand owner as a necessary party for warranty enforcement.
Ask client for annual income certificate/details and any SC/ST/disability/women-headed-household status to reassess eligibility under Legal Services Authorities Act criteria.
Have client review, sign, and verify the complaint with correct date before filing; unverified pleadings can be rejected.

red_flags.flag: No proof of prior written demand/notice to opposite party on record
red_flags.action: Check if a written notice/demand for repair was sent and annex it; strengthens deficiency claim and may be needed to establish date of cause of action.

vulnerability_notes: No protected category identified yet; income and other eligibility details still to be confirmed with client.

refer_out.why: Matter is a routine consumer complaint within clinic's competence; supervising advocate review before filing is sufficient. Escalate only if limitation is found to have already lapsed or if criminal/fraud elements (e.g., counterfeit warranty denial) emerge.
